title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical street
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical street-fashion portrait of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, standing casually in a narrow urban side street beside a tall white metal security fence and outdoor utility equipment. Her ethnicity or race is unspecified and should not be inferred from appearance alone. She has smooth fair skin with soft neutral undertones and realistic natural texture, a slender softly tapered oval face, a delicate jawline, subtle cheek contours, a small straight nose, naturally shaped muted-red lips, and dark brown almond-shaped eyes. Her eyebrows are dark, straight-to-softly arched, and neatly groomed. She looks directly toward the camera with a calm, slightly serious and introspective expression, lips relaxed and closed, her head gently tilted toward one shoulder.

Her hair is very dark brown to black, long, straight, and naturally textured, falling loosely past her shoulders and down across her chest. It is parted slightly off-center, with soft face-framing strands around both cheeks and subtle flyaways for realism.

She stands facing the camera with her torso relaxed and slightly angled, leaning subtly toward the white wire fence behind her. Her hips are shifted naturally to one side. One hand is tucked casually into the pocket of her sweatpants, while the other hangs near her hip holding a large black soft leather or nylon handbag with gathered detailing, straps, metal hardware, and a small decorative flower charm.

She wears exactly a fitted pale powder-blue short-sleeve cropped T-shirt ending above the waist, revealing a narrow section of her midriff. Across the front is large bold red collegiate-style lettering reading “NUMBER ONE GIRL,” arranged over several lines. She pairs it with loose light-heather-gray drawstring sweatpants with an elastic waistband and relaxed wide legs. A thin bracelet is visible on one wrist.

The setting is a realistic Japanese-style urban service alley: white metal fencing dominates the right side, enclosing large gray outdoor air-conditioning units and industrial fixtures, while concrete and tiled building façades line the opposite side. A projecting convenience-store-style sign appears overhead in the background, with additional small commercial signage farther down the street. Use bright overcast daylight, soft shadow transitions, natural skin highlights, and slightly cool neutral color grading. Shot at eye level with a 28–35mm full-frame lens, moderate environmental perspective, crisp subject detail, subtle background depth, documentary fashion-photography realism, natural smartphone-camera immediacy, high dynamic range, no artificial glamour lighting, no excessive retouching. 3:4
